name: Civic GovUK Cookie Control
description: Integrates Civic Cookie Control module with DWP Design System for use with all public facing DWP services
project_description: Submodule of Civic Cookie Control. Provides a GOV.UK Design System styled cookie-consent banner (and details block) for public-facing UK government / DWP services, as an alternative front end to the standard Civic widget. It reuses the parent module's configuration and alternative-language config entities, adds its own text strings (accepted/rejected/change-settings labels) and renders a Drupal block from a GOV.UK-classed Twig template. Requires the language and config_translation modules for multilingual banner text.
